title: Research: six-label UT3(F4) triple still costs 12 after adjoining w^2 (answers #3774; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers the six-label question left open by [#3774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3774). In `F_2[UT_3(F_4)]`, every word in the six involutions

```text
X_1, X_w, X_{w^2}, Y_1, Y_w, Y_{w^2}
```

with rank-one idempotent calls that realizes

```text
diag([Z_1], [Z_w], [Z_{w^2}])
```

on three registers, and the identity on every extra dirty register, has length at least **12**.

The coefficient `w^2=(1,1)` meets both `F_2` summands, so the four-label complementary split does not apply. On the mixed word the `{1,w}` shadows span only `span{e_0,e_1}` (dimension 2). The third direction is the lift column `(e_2,e_2)`. The diagonal-lift inequality replaces the split: if `U` has columns `(α_0 u, α_1 u)`, then `dim span{u} ≤ rank(U)`. With the inherited corner and row-space bounds this still forces `n_X≥6` and `n_Y≥6`.

Two twelve-call words attain the endpoint. The mixed word is `[X_1,Y_1]`, `[X_w,Y_1]`, `[X_{w^2},Y_1]`. The both-new word is `[X_1,Y_1]`, `[X_{w^2},Y_{w^2}]`, `[X_w,Y_w]`. Each has `n_X=6` and `n_Y=6`. `[X_{w^2},Y_1]=(0,0,w^2)` and `[X_{w^2},Y_{w^2}]=(0,0,w)`.

The lower bound is the diagonal-lift count, not an exhaustive search of length 11. A length-11 word would need one letter class of length at most 5, which the inequality forbids for every finite `r≥3`. Machine checks cover the group law (order 64), both schedules, a restored spectator, single omissions, and `dim span{u} ≤ rank(U)` on all 82160 subsets of size at most 6 of the 21 pure columns in `r=3`. The step from that census to every `r≥3` is the `φ`-Δ dimension count in the proof.

**Scope.** Six axis involutions and rank-one idempotents only. This does not reprint the four-label theorem, does not use the fourteen-call composite, and does not reopen the two-register minimum 8 from [#2261](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2261). `12α` is a formal per-call price in this alphabet, not a supplier, hosting, or κ improvement.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction/`
- Tip: `595b9426cc2fac34d31a71b24b98ed080f54c99a`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **changed** — six-label obstruction, not a reprint of the four-label minimum

Closest prior: [#3774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3774) (open; four-label exact minimum 12; explicit that `X_{w^2}` and `Y_{w^2}` are unproved because they break the `{1,w}` summand split). The nilpotent expansion and the disjoint four-call commutator shape are that argument with two letters added. The new step is the diagonal-lift inequality, which that split cannot cite.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_UT3_F4_W2_LIFT six_label_minimum=12 labels=6 mixed_word=12 both_new_labels=12 nX=6 nY=6 blind_span=2 lift_rank=3 shadow_subsets=82160 spectator=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_UT3_F4_W2_LIFT_INDEPENDENT minimum=12 labels=6 mixed=12 both_new=12 blind_span=2 lift_rank=3 no_new_kappa
PASS_UT3_F4_W2_LIFT_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=3
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/ut3-f4-w2-lift-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. A temporary copy of `CERTIFICATE.json` with a corrupted field is rejected, and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.

## Credit

Credit Cinna Davis / [#2261](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2261) for the two-register minimum and the open three-output question. Credit the four-label dependent-central-triple note ([#3774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3774)) for posing the `w^2` question. The rank-one idempotent register model follows the eumemic / woklerx address-call lineage used there. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can rank-one calls that are not idempotent reduce this six-label triple below 12? Keep the six axis labels, drop `N^2=N`, and test whether a nilpotent factor can feed a three-dimensional corner. The blocker is that `v·u=0` kills every quadratic scalar `v_X·u_Y`, so the present normal form does not admit those factors.
2. Can one of these twelve formal calls be realized in a pinned bit supplier below one rank-one complete price? Charge frame changes, hosting, restoration, and dispatch for either twelve-call word. No legal physical realization is supplied here.
